subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw accept custom `bailian` configured-model Qwen compat inference as a supported core behavior, or keep Bailian reasoning support only in Qwen/provider-owned bundled paths?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes provider capability inference for existing custom configs and crosses the provider-owner boundary unless maintainers explicitly accept the custom-provider behavior.

options.title: Accept Narrow Custom Bailian Inference
options.body: After removing the vLLM hook change and adding changed-path proof/tests, treat `bailian` custom rows with Qwen compat formats like the existing vLLM inference path.

options.title: Fold Into Qwen Coding Plan Work
options.body: Reject this core special-case and require the remaining work to land through the broader Qwen/Coding Plan provider-owned issue and PRs.

options.title: Require Stronger Vendor Proof First
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers have model-by-model Alibaba proof that this default is safe for existing custom Bailian configs.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Custom Bailian Inference
recommendation.body: After removing the vLLM hook change and adding changed-path proof/tests, treat `bailian` custom rows with Qwen compat formats like the existing vLLM inference path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Qwen provider surface and prior review context already routed the broader Bailian/Coding Plan decision through maintainer review.
